Its dev script is a bare `next dev`, so it takes Next's default. With no explicit -p, Next retries upward on EADDRINUSE and silently starts on 3001 instead, which is why this number needs a record even though no config file states it. It is also deploy-dev-server.sh's DEV_PORT fallback.

Every production app listens on 3000 inside its own Docker network, behind one Caddy, with `expose:` rather than a host `ports:` publish. Deliberately shared — a container network is not a shared namespace — and recorded so that nobody reads the four as a collision.
Tailnet front port for what-is-next's dev server on 3939. Allocated by deploy-dev-server.sh; the origin cannot share its own number.
